question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"inflict."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Inflict"** means to cause something unpleasant or harmful to be suffered by someone or something. (किसी को अप्रिय या अनचाही बात मानने के लिए विवश करना, ज़बरदस्‍ती लादना) • **Example**: *Don’t **inflict**__ your problems on me—I’ve got enough of my own.* • The verb form of **"inflict"** is used with an object, as in** "He inflicted a lot of pain on his opponent."** • **"Inflict"** is often used in the context of punishment or harm being caused intentionally. • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: Humans have __assumed__ that animals do not have a life and maybe exploited in any way they see fit, but this __perspective__ is incorrect and must be altered before it is too late. We fail to recognise that the pain we __**inflict**__ on animals will come back to haunt us, and no matter how ______ (4) ______ the discovery we make by causing harm to animals, it will be futile. It can never ______ (5) ______ the human actions. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Convict"** means to find someone guilty of a crime. (न्‍यायालय द्वारा अपराधी या दोषी ठहराया जाना) • **"Afflict" **means to cause pain or suffering to someone or something. (दुख देना, सताना, पीड़ित करना) • **"Conflict"** means a disagreement or clash between two or more people or things. (किसी अन्‍य से असहमत या भिन्‍न होना; प्रतिकूल या विरोधी होना, मेल न खाना) 40:Tf0a, The correct answer is **"significant."**
